verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a publishable, hosted Trust Center with a custom domain. Control-monitoring data is pulled continuously into it, and visitors can self-serve or request sensitive security documents, with admins able to approve or deny requests and enforce an NDA. missing for 10: explicit evidence that certifications/badges are displayed, confirmation that the NDA is a self-serve click-through rather than admin-gated, any evidence of reduced security-review effort, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I get a hosted public trust center — live control status, certifications, and reports shared under click-through NDA — that closes security reviews before they start

citations.quote: Publish a Trust Center for prospects and customers to find information about the measures your organization is taking to ensure a robust security position.
Data – like monitoring checks on security controls – is pulled continuously from Secureframe, but admins may choose to hide or display content on their Trust Center.
From your Trust Center, visitors can self-serve or request sensitive security documents. Admins at your organization can review/approve/deny requests and enforce an NDA
set up a custom domain with your organization's logo and colors
